title: A Village After the Storm
paragraphs: Badai besar sedang melanda desa kecil itu pada suatu malam. Hujan turun sangat deras, dan angin kencang mengguncang atap setiap rumah sederhana. Banyak keluarga tetap terjaga, tidak bisa tidur karena kebisingan itu.

Saat badai masih berlangsung di luar, para tetangga diam-diam saling memeriksa keselamatan lewat jendela dan telepon. Satu keluarga sedang memasak nasi dan sup hangat lebih banyak untuk dibagikan kepada siapa pun yang membutuhkannya malam itu.

Menjelang pagi, badai akhirnya mereda, dan langit mulai kembali tenang. Beberapa pria memeriksa atap yang rusak bersama-sama, sementara yang lain membersihkan ranting yang jatuh di jalan utama sebelum orang-orang berangkat kerja.

Jika dikenang, warga desa sering berkata bahwa badai itu justru mempererat kebersamaan mereka sebagai komunitas. Mereka masih ingat bagaimana semua orang bekerja berdampingan pagi itu, tanpa perlu diminta dua kali.
answerKey: A big storm was hitting the small village late one night. Rain was falling very hard, and strong wind was shaking the roofs of every simple house. Many families were staying awake, unable to fall asleep during the noise. While the storm was still happening outside, the neighbors were quietly checking on each other's safety through their windows and phones. One family was cooking extra rice and warm soup to share with anyone who needed it that night. By early morning, the storm was finally ending, and the sky was becoming calm again. Several men were checking the damaged roofs together, while others were clearing fallen branches from the main road before people left for work. Looking back, the villagers often say that the storm actually brought them closer together as a community. They still remember how everyone worked side by side that morning, without anyone needing to be asked twice.
